scope: Fresh synthetic cases; full product and matched baseline runner must be specified before scoring. Not an overall superiority claim.
runnerStatus: Not run; shared instruction and runner contract verification required before live scoring.
arms: Installed AgentForge chat → reviewed plan → isolated execution → restart/recovery → artifact chat
Direct same-model JSON plan → reviewed isolated execution
order: Task order as listed; trials 1 through 3; AgentForge then direct for odd trials, direct then AgentForge for even trials
fairness: Same frozen task and input bytes, model, thinking disabled, output-token cap and no network during execution
Both arms read input.json at runtime and write artifacts/result.json; only artifacts/** writable
Expected answers and evaluator code never staged in the task repository or sent to a model
Reviewer may accept or reject commands but never edit, give hints, or request a replacement plan
Each arm has the same maximum provider-call budget; direct baseline uses one plan request, with actual usage reported rather than equal spending assumed
No automatic retries or replacement of failed attempts; infrastructure failures retained separately
Artifact accuracy is comparable across arms; onboarding, recovery and final chat are additional AgentForge requirements and are not scored as baseline failures
This is an internal baseline comparison, not evidence of superiority over other products

scoring.artifact: Exact JSON equality, unchanged input SHA-256 and regular files; extra fields fail
scoring.journey: AgentForge additionally completes reviewed execution, recovery without replay, final approval and artifact-grounded chat
report: All 18 attempts including rejection, invalid plan and provider failure
Exact source commit, package hash and Docker image ID
Provider request counts and reported usage; absent cost remains unknown
Monotonic total elapsed time, provider time and reviewer wait recorded separately
No new development on frozen cases after inspecting live output; repairs require separate labeled development evidence
